messages.subject: File upload in shiny
parts: Dear All, I am finally interested in Shiny. I already figure out to upload csv file. But I want to figure out that choose between csv or internal dataset to use. I can get and work internal dataset alone and I can choose external csv alone. However in same app I can not merge this two option together. fileInput("file1", "Choose CSV File", multiple = TRUE, accept = c("text/csv", "text/comma-separated-values,text/plain", ".csv")), AND selectInput("file1", "Choose a dataset:", choices = c("rock", "pressure", "cars")), is it possible to choose one of them in same app. Because some my calculation needs csv, some of them uses internal data set. I do not want to make two different app. My best regards
